summary.text: Elvi Gray-Jackson has served in the Alaska Senate for District G since 2019.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she worked for the Municipality of Anchorage, including as director of the Budget and Legislative Services Office of the Anchorage Assembly, and later at Municipal Light and Power.
It says she served on the Anchorage Assembly from 2008 to 2017, chairing it from April 2016 to April 2017, and is a graduate of the University of Alaska Anchorage.
